name: Review & Governance {OS}
tagline: Cross-OS learning and approval of consequential change.

commands.name: /review
commands.summary: Open a review at the default cadence and drive it to decisions with owners.

commands.name: /daily-review
commands.summary: Run the short daily reflection against what was intended.

commands.name: /monthly-review
commands.summary: Run the metrics review against thresholds, and the systemic findings.

commands.name: /quarterly-review
commands.summary: Run strategic governance: policy, decision rights, risk, change portfolio.

commands.name: /postmortem
commands.summary: Analyse an incident blamelessly and produce one owned change.

commands.name: /policy
commands.summary: Create or audit a written policy with scope, owner, exceptions and review date.

commands.name: /change-request
commands.summary: Authorise a consequential change, with conditions, reversal path and verification test.

commands.name: /risk-register
commands.summary: Review risks: trigger, response, owner, review date.

commands.name: /ai-governance
commands.summary: Assess an AI system's decision limits and name its human oversight point.

commands.name: /verify-change
commands.summary: Judge an approved change after the fact: standardise, adjust or revert.

requires_human_approval_for: publishing or amending a policy that binds other people
accepting a risk rather than mitigating it
reverting a change other people are relying on
recording anything about an individual's conduct in a postmortem
allowing an AI system to act on a consequential decision without a human in the path
